tools.name: get_project_state
tools.title: Inspect ProjectV2
tools.description: Read the committed V2 site, terrain, buildings, shared slabs, wall graph, spaces, openings, landscape, climate, evidence-linked planting recommendations, soil analysis, metrics and variants.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Read the committed V2 site, terrain, buildings, shared slabs, wall graph, spaces, openings, landscape, climate, evidence-linked planting recommendations, soil analysis, metrics and variants.
prompt.input: `detail` (enum): `summary`, `site`, `structure`, `landscape`, or `full`. `landscape` returns placed landscape, climate and the planting guide, including documented soil findings, unknowns, required tests, preparation principles, vegetables and fruit trees.
prompt.tools: Use before proposing edits or requesting views. This is read-only. Treat conditional crop recommendations and unknown soil properties as constraints, not verified suitability.
prompt.output: Call this WebMCP tool with a JSON object. Read content[0].text as JSON containing status, projectRevision and summary plus tool-specific fields. Never treat visible report image object URLs as tool output.

tools.name: get_proposals

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.

tools.name: propose_roof_update
tools.title: Propose roof or segment update
tools.description: Update, add, or atomically split semantic roof segments while preserving explicit support links, perpendicular ridge directions, finishes, and typed valley/intersection junctions.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Update, add, or atomically split semantic roof segments while preserving explicit support links, perpendicular ridge directions, finishes, and typed valley/intersection junctions.
prompt.input: Input is a JSON object with required `buildingRef` and `action` (`update`, `add-segment`, or `split-segment`; default `update`). For `update`, optional `roofRef` or `segmentRef` selects the complete roof or one segment; segment updates may set `footprint`, `ridgeDirection` (`x` or `z`), `storeyRef`, and `spaceRef`. For `add-segment`, require new `segmentRef`, polygon `footprint`, and `ridgeDirection`; optional support, geometry, elevation, and finish fields initialize it. For `split-segment`, require the malformed source `segmentRef`, `segments` with at least two complete replacement definitions (`segmentRef`, `footprint`, `ridgeDirection`, optional `storeyRef`, `spaceRef`, geometry, elevation, and finish), and `junctions` with stable `ref`, `type` (`valley` or `intersection`), and exactly two `segmentRefs`. Replacement fields omitted during a split inherit from the source segment. Common geometry fields are `roofType`, `pitchDegrees` (0–70), and `overhangM` (0–3). Use at most one vertical instruction: `baseElevationM`, `targetEavesElevationM`, `verticalDeltaM`, or `alignToSegmentRef` with optional `alignEdge` (`eaves` or `ridge`). Finish fields are `material` and six-digit `colorHex`; `synchronization` is `roof-only`, `roof-and-supporting-walls`, or `storey-height`.

Never treat visible report image object URLs as tool output. Create and add actions return the draft audit; finalize returns status "variant_created" with variantRef and the complete operation audit; discard removes only the uncommitted draft.

Discard immediately returns status "rejected" without changing the committed project. Proposal history retains either decision.
